{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Black dragons}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = Normal |version2 = Myths' Guild |name = Baby black dragon |image = [[File:Baby black dragon.png|250px]] |release = [[15 March]] [[2006]] |update = Hundredth Quest - Recipe for Disaster! |members = Yes |combat = 83 |size = 2 |examine = Young but still dangerous. |attributes = dragon |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 11 |aggressive = Yes (except in Myths' Guild and Charred Dungeon) |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 4 |slayxp = 80 |cat = Black Dragons |assignedby = konar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints = 80 |att = 70 |str = 70 |def = 70 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 50 |dcrush = 50 |dmagic = 40 |dlight = 30 |dstandard = 30 |dheavy = 5 |elementalweaknesstype1 = Water |elementalweaknesstype2 = |elementalweaknesspercent1 = 50 |elementalweaknesspercent2 = |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 1871,1872 |id2 = 7955 |leagueRegion = Misthalin,Asgarnia,Kandarin |respawn=30 ticks (18 seconds), except Taverly Dungeon, where it is 15 ticks (9 seconds)}} '''Baby black dragons''' are the young of adult [[black dragon]]s and are the strongest baby dragons in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. Unlike their adult form, they are too young to breathe flames, so no [[anti-dragon shield]] or other protection from [[dragonbreath]] is needed to fight them. Baby black dragons have combat stats comparable to those of an adult [[green dragon]]. They can be killed as an alternative for a black dragon [[Slayer task]]. The baby black dragon in the [[Myths' Guild]] basement lacks the [[elemental weakness]] to [[water spells]] possessed by those in the Evil Chicken's Lair and Taverley Dungeon. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Baby black dragon |location = [[Charred Dungeon]] |levels = 83 |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |x:2648,y:8875|x:2652,y:8879|x:2657,y:8876|x:2659,y:8843|x:2664,y:8847|x:2667,y:8842|x:2670,y:8848 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = N/A }} {{LocLine |name = Baby black dragon |location = [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]]/[[Myths' Guild|Myths' Guild (basement)]]Requires completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]] |levels = 83 |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |plane = 1 |1888,9003 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} {{LocLine |name = Baby black dragon |location = [[Evil Chicken's Lair]]Requires a [[rope]] and partial completion of [[Recipe for Disaster: Sir Amik Varze]] |levels = 83 |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |plane = 0 |x:2438,y:4393 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Misthalin&Fremennik }} {{LocLine |name = Baby black dragon |location = [[Taverley Dungeon]] (upper level) Requires a black dragon [[Slayer task]]. |levels = 83 |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |plane = 1 |2817,9818|2820,9819|2824,9818|2858,9828|2862,9826 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Babydragon bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Brimstone key|quantity=1|rarity={{Brimstone rarity|83}}|raritynotes=Only dropped if killed on a [[Slayer task]] given by [[Konar quo Maten]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/1083783815141707781|date=16 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97247|archivedate=29 April 2020|quote=0.2*(CBLEVEL -
